core_categories: Pharmacy; Health & Beauty Retail; Prescription Services; Healthcare Consultations
specialty_focus: Boots UK is a pharmacy-led health and beauty retailer operating around 1,800 stores across the UK, ranging from community pharmacies to destination beauty stores. It offers prescription services, healthcare consultations, and a broad retail mix focused on health and wellbeing. While it may stock some wearable health devices, its primary focus is not specifically on wearable medical devices.
